info.title: Tempera Voice API
info.summary: Provider-neutral realtime voice control plane for the Tempera ecosystem
info.description: Wrap existing realtime voice models without retraining. Tempera Voice owns session state, turn policy, MCP tool mediation, approvals, and verified outcomes; Palette owns traces/replay/gates and tempera-evals owns benchmark and evidence logic.

patch.description:
Write an agent by name (AIP-134).

With no `updateMask` the body replaces the agent outright, and creates
it when it does not exist yet. With a mask only the named top-level
fields are taken from the body; the rest of the stored agent survives,
so a caller that only wants to change `voice` cannot silently reset a
tool policy it never sent.

agent. Ambiguity is reported rather than resolved by guessing.

ActionEffect.title: ActionEffect
ActionEffect.description:
The seven-class effect vocabulary shared across the Tempera ecosystem.

The class states what an action *is*, so a spoken read-back can say what is
about to happen without paraphrasing an opaque argument dictionary.

DispatchState.title: DispatchState
DispatchState.description:
Whether the request behind an action actually left this deployment.

There are exactly three honest answers. `unknown` is not a failure mode to
be smoothed away: it is the state that opens a reconciliation item instead
of reporting either success or failure.

Status.description: The google.rpc.Status error envelope required of every Tempera API (AIP-193).

code.description: The HTTP status code, repeated in the body so the envelope is self-describing.

status.description: The canonical google.rpc.Code name, for example INVALID_ARGUMENT.
